_comment: CAGE Governance Thresholds — single source of truth. Loaded and Pydantic-validated at gateway startup. All modules MUST reference the loaded singleton; never inline literals.
_env_override_comment: All thresholds support env var overrides for runtime tuning. Env var names follow the pattern: uppercase path with underscores (e.g., fria.zone_allow -> FRIA_ZONE_ALLOW).

drawdown._comment: Maximum allowable portfolio drawdown as a fraction (0.0–1.0). Maps to safety_params.json drawdown_limit.

stpa._comment: UCA-5: drawdown > this value triggers Unsafe Control Action block.
UCA-6: order_size > daily_vol * this fraction triggers slippage violation.
FIN-1: maximum fraction of portfolio_total that can be sold in one order.
FIN-2: maximum permissible round-trip latency for a trade action.

fria._comment: FRIA (Frontier Risk Impact Assessment) confidence threshold for automatic approval.
FRIA confidence threshold below which action is deferred to HITL.

confidence._comment: [CTRL_AGT_001] Minimum agentic model confidence required to execute a trade. See config/control_mappings.json for the active regulatory framework mapping (primary: ISO 42001 §A.5.2; legacy citation: SR 26-2 §IV.B).
confidence._comment_agent: [EV-2] Agent confidence threshold — consolidated from AGENT_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD env var.
confidence._comment_min_score: [EV-5] Minimum confidence threshold for confabulation scorer — below this value, requests are blocked due to confabulation risk. Consolidated from CONFIDENCE_MIN_SCORE env var. Production deployments may override via secretKeyRef.

causal._comment_pvalue: Standard frequentist significance level for causal lock decisions. Consistent with SR 26-2 MRM back-testing requirements (CTRL_TEL_003).
causal._comment_placebo: If absolute placebo refuter new_effect exceeds this, estimated causal effect is unreliable. 0.2 corresponds to Cohen's d ≈ 0.2 (medium effect).
causal._comment_risk: If (0.5 + estimated_marginal_effect) exceeds this, trade is predicted to push risk above safety boundary. Leaves 5% safety margin.
causal._comment_samples: [EV-4] Consolidated from CAUSAL_MIN_SAMPLES and CAUSAL_MIN_LIVE_SAMPLES. Minimum telemetry samples required for causal model training.
causal._comment_bucket: [F2] Monotone amount buckets for cache key. Verdicts are amount-dependent; bucketing prevents small-amount verdicts from leaking to large-amount requests. Boundaries in USD.

telemetry._comment_staleness: [EV-6] Maximum age of telemetry observation (seconds) before data is treated as stale and causal gatekeeper fails closed. Env override: TELEMETRY_MAX_STALENESS_SECONDS.
telemetry._comment_cache: [EV-6] TTL for Redis-backed causal result cache (seconds). Set to 0 to disable caching. Env override: CAUSAL_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS.

kms_batch._comment_max_size: [EV-5] Maximum records per KMS batch signing operation. Env override: KMS_BATCH_MAX_SIZE.
kms_batch._comment_enabled: [EV-5] KMS batch signing disabled by default for safety. Enable explicitly in production. Env override: KMS_BATCH_ENABLED.

consensus._comment: Trades above this USD amount trigger the multi-agent consensus check.

tier1_keywords: ACT AS A DEVELOPER WITH ROOT ACCESS
_comment_cbrn: AI 600-1 §2.6 CBRN keyword list — US_FED only. Enabled when tier1_keywords_cbrn_enabled=true.

healthcare._comment_min: Minimum therapeutic drug concentration (mg/L) for serum barrier.
healthcare._comment_max: Maximum safe drug concentration (mg/L) — exceeding this is toxic.
healthcare._comment_gamma: CBF decay factor for healthcare serum barrier — more conservative than finance (0.5).
